root_cause.text: The kernel’s netfilter xt_cgroup and xt_rateest match extensions accept user-supplied path and name strings without verifying they are null-terminated, allowing potential out-of-bounds reads when these strings are passed to C-string functions.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `strnlen(info->path, sizeof(info->path)) >= sizeof(info->path)` checks in `cgroup_mt_check_v1` and `cgroup_mt_check_v2`, and similar checks for `info->name1` and `info->name2` in `xt_rateest_mt_checkentry`. These guard against non-null-terminated strings that would cause `cgroup_get_from_path()` or `xt_rateest_lookup()` to read past the end of the buffer.
